errors.where: pink stamp and postmark on the envelope
errors.what: The stamp and postmark sit on the flap side (the back) of the envelope, next to the open flap. Stamps go on the address side.

cards.fix: Move the stamp and postmark to the flat front of the envelope, or remove them from the flap side.

errors.where: checkerboard on the stone table top
errors.what: The board has about 7 columns by 6 rows instead of the 8x8 squares a chess or checkers board needs.

cards.fix: Make the inlaid board a proper 8x8 checkerboard with alternating squares.

errors.where: bottom edges of the stacked maps
errors.what: The maps are folded like thick, rigid booklets. Each has a rounded, padded bottom hem and a white border that wraps around the fold, so they read as stiff folders, not paper. A paper map cannot fold this way.

cards.fix: Draw the treasure maps as thin flat paper sheets, either lying flat in a loose stack or with crisp, thin accordion folds, with no thick rounded hem at the bottom.
